cardOverview.overviewText: A SimplyClick Advantage variant offering higher earn rates on digital transactions, milestone partner e-vouchers, and exclusive online shopping discounts, perfect for frequent e-commerce users.

items.child: Get an Amazon gift card worth Rs 500 on joining.
Use this card to book railway tickets online on the IRCTC website.

benefitRows.name: Amazon
benefitRows.description: Get an Amazon gift card worth Rs 500 on joining.
benefitRows.howToAvail: The Amazon (Redeemable on Amazon.in or its mobile application) voucher worth Rs.500. Voucher Code will be sent on customer’s registered mobile number within 21 days from payment of membership fee of 499.

benefitRows.name: IRCTC
benefitRows.description: Use this card to book railway tickets online on the IRCTC website.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, book your railway tickets on the IRCTC website using your SBI SimplyClick Advantage credit card. Complete payment via your credit card for secure transactions. For support, contact SBI customer care at 1800 180 1290.
